valid: export const value = input as string;

Two adjacent assertions repeat the same call as their first argument.
This substring assertion restates an imported constant as a literal.

invalid.message: Methods and functions must not exceed 7 parameters (found 8). Refactor to use a parameter object.
Use of import() inside other statements (for example in an if, a function, or a loop) is prohibited. All imports must be at the top level.
Dynamic imports (import(...)) are prohibited without a documented reason.

Re-exporting entities from other modules (for example 'export { ... } from ...' or 'export * from ...') is prohibited. Each module must only export entities it defines.
